paite: Ahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm; apu David bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih kei hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz / (2 Kum 16.1-4)

paite: Israel kumpipate lampi azui zaw a, Baalte a ding in milim suntawmte abawl lai hi.
Hinnom tapa phaizang ah gimlimte ahal a, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih sek bang un atate uh mei ah alutsak uhi.
Mun sangte, mualte, sing hing nuaite ah akithoih a, gimlimte ahal zel hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA a Pathian in Siria kumpipa khut ah apia a; asual ua, mi tampi sal in api ua, Damaskas ah apaipih uhi. Israel kumpipa khut a piak ahi lai a, ama'n tampi athat hi.
heading: Siria Leh Israel Toh Kidouna / (2 Kum 16.5)

paite: Api-le-pute uh TOUPA Pathian alehngatsan ziak un. Remaliah tapa Pekah in Judah gam ah nuaikhat-le-singnih ni khat in athat a, avek un mihangsan chiat ahi uhi.
Ephraim mihat Jikri in kumpipa tapa Maaseiah leh insung upa Azrikam leh Elkanah, kumpipa zom athat hi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n a-unaute uh nuainih, numeite, atapate uh, atanute uh sal in api ua; gallak tamtak alaksak lai ua, gallak pen Samaria ah atun uhi.

Huai ah TOUPA zawlnei ana om a, amin Obed ahi; Samaria a hong pai ding sepaihte ana vaidawn a, akiang uah, "Ngai dih uh, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian Judahte tung ah aheh a, na khut ua hon pia ei ve, heh a na thahna un van asuntou hi.
heading: Zawlnei Obed

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem mite sikhanu leh sikhapa in bawl na tum ua, himahleh noute ngei in leng TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na hihkhial uh ahi kei maw?
Huaiziak in ka thu pom unla, na unaute uh sal a na matte uh paisak nawn un; TOUPA hehna thupitak na tung uah a-om hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Ephraimte heutu khenkhat, Johanan tapa Azariahte, Mesillemoth tapa Berekiahte, Shallum tapa Jehizkiah, Hadlai tapa Amasa kidouna a kipan a hong paite ana dal ua, akiang uah,

"Salte na hon pilut ding uh ahi kei; ka khelhna uh leh ka tatlekna uh behlap in, TOUPA tung ah tatlekna na hon tungsak ding uh ahi, ka khelhna uh athupi mahmah ngal a, Israel mite tung ah hehna thupitak a-om hi," ana chi uhi.
Huchi in sepaihte'n miliante leh mipi ma ah salte leh gallak sumte anusia uh.

Huan minlohlouhte ahong thou ua, salte api ua, gallak thil in vuaktang a om teng puansilh aguan ua, avan ua, khedapte abunsak ua, nek ding leh dawn ding apia ua, sathau anilh ua, ahatloute tengteng sabiltung ah atuangsak ua, tum sing khua, Jeriko ah a-unaute uh kiang ah apaisak ua, amau Samaria ah akik nawnta uhi.
Huai lai in kumpipa Ahaz in Assuria kumpipate panpihna ngen ding in mi asawl hi.
heading: Ahaz In Assuria Panpihna Angen / (2 Kum 16.7-9)

paite: Edomte'n Judahte va sual a, sal dia hon mat thuk ziak un.
Philistiate'n leng phailam khuate leh Judah simte ahong la ua, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Sokoh leh akhotate toh, huan, Timnah leh akhotate, Gimzo leng akhotate toh ala ua, huai ah a-om uhi.
Israel kumpipa Ahaz ziak in TOUPA'N Judahte avuallelsak hi. Judahte tung ah thanghuaitak in thil ahih a, TOUPA tung ah nakpitak in akhial ahi.
Huchi in Siria kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser akiang ah ahong pai a, hihhat nak sang in ahihmangbang zaw hi.
Ahaz in TOUPA' inn, kumpipa' inn leh miliante a pan thilte ala a, Siria kumpipa apia a; himahleh aphatuam tuan kei.
Amangbat laitak in leng hiai kumpipa Ahaz in TOUPA tung ah thil ahihkhial semsem mawk hi.
heading: Ahaz Khelhnate

paite: Amah sualmi Damaskaste pathian kiang ah akithoih hi, “Siria kumpipate' pathian in amaute apanpih ziak in kei leng ahon panpih theihna ding in akiang ah ka kithoih ding ahi," achi hi. Himahleh amah leh Israel mi tengteng siatna ahi ngal a.
Huchi in Ahaz in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan akaikhawm vek a, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ahihkham vek a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte akhak bikbek a; Jerusalem ning chih ah maitam abawl hi.
Judah kho tampi ah pathian dangte dia gimlim halna mun sangte abawl a, TOUPA api-le-pute Pathian ahehsak hi.
Athilhih dangte tengteng leh a-omdan tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in ngai dih, Judate leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Api-le-pute kiang ah Ahaz a-ihmu a, Jerusalem khopi ah avui ua; Israel kumpipate han ah akoih kei uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Hezekiah in vai ahawmta hi.
